linearization_order.name: EstablishRequiredPairModeFromStaticMarker
linearization_order.description: Reads _staticPairModeRequired under lock before any property accesses to establish _isPairRequiredMode = true.

linearization_order.name: RetainManagedOwnerSafely
linearization_order.description: Obtains this.gameObject in try/catch to protect against native wrapper failures and sets _retainedOwner.

linearization_order.name: CheckPriorAbortUnderLock
linearization_order.description: Checks _staticStartupAborted under lock before transfer; if aborted, clears matching payload and direct-returns fail-closed.

linearization_order.name: TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff
linearization_order.description: Acquires pending startup handoff and cohort identity; fail-closed on mismatch.

linearization_order.name: ValidateInstalledParentReceiptBeforeResources
linearization_order.description: Validates _activeAdmissionReceipt != null && _activeAdmissionReceipt.IsValid() BEFORE fastEcology, callback subscription, policy setup, listener, or thread. On failure, calls RevokeReadiness and throws to catch for safe owned failure cleanup.

linearization_order.name: SuppressFastEcologyAndSubscribeLogCallback
linearization_order.description: Explicitly disables fastEcology and subscribes Application.logMessageReceived += HandleUnityLogMessage outside any lock.

linearization_order.name: ConfigurePackagePolicyAndConstructResources
linearization_order.description: Applies package policy and constructs TcpListener and Thread outside lock. Zero I/O or configuration execution inside critical section.

linearization_order.name: ResourceStartCriticalAdmissionCommit
linearization_order.description: Under _startupHandoffLock, checks _staticStartupAborted. If aborted, throws to rollback and reject start. Otherwise calls listener.Start(), listenerThread.Start(), and sets _startupInitializationComplete = true atomically. Rolls back via inner catch on exception.

linearization_order.name: GuardedCatchFailureRollback
linearization_order.description: On any exception during Awake, sets _startupInitializationComplete = false, isRunning = false, marks _staticStartupAborted = true under lock, guards Log.Error, and independently executes teardown for log callback, listener, thread, and handoff payload.

concurrency_limits.single_mutex_discipline: _startupHandoffLock is the sole lock; zero nested locks; zero circular wait.
concurrency_limits.no_blocking_in_lock: Zero Thread.Join, Monitor.Wait, or thread sleep while holding lock.
concurrency_limits.no_unbound_calls_in_lock: Zero logging, Unity engine callbacks, or custom user code executed while holding lock.
concurrency_limits.post_commit_abort_limitation: A single entry fence guarantees that an abort published before resource admission prevents listener/thread start. Post-commit runtime abort handling remains bounded by native thread and socket lifecycle.
